PAGE_ABOUT_INTRO: A community platform for discovering upcoming Tablighi Jamaat opportunities in Bangladesh.
PAGE_ABOUT_S1_P: Information about upcoming Jamaat departures usually spreads through personal contacts, mosques and messaging groups. Jamaat Connect gives the community one place to look.
PAGE_ABOUT_S2_P: Anyone can search listings without an account. Signed-in members can submit a listing. Every submission is reviewed by a moderator and only approved listings become public.
PAGE_ABOUT_S3_P: We protect private contact details, we do not claim that any person or group is religiously endorsed, and we aim to keep the platform accurate, respectful and easy to use on any phone.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_INTRO: Help us keep Jamaat Connect accurate, safe and respectful.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_S1_P: Only submit listings you have good reason to believe are real. Give correct dates, locations and duration, and update or withdraw a listing if plans change.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_S2_P: Never post other people’s phone numbers, addresses or personal details in a public listing. Use the private contact fields, which are not shown publicly.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_S3_P: Do not submit spam, duplicates, false information, or content that is hateful, harassing or inappropriate.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_S4_P: Send enquiries only for genuine questions about a listing. Repeated or abusive messages may be limited or blocked.
PAGE_GUIDELINES_S5_P: Moderators may approve, ask for changes, reject or suspend a listing, and may restrict accounts that repeatedly break these guidelines.
PAGE_HELP_S1_P: Open Search, then filter by location, departure date, duration and availability. You do not need an account to browse.
PAGE_HELP_S2_P: Open a listing and send a private enquiry. Your phone or WhatsApp number is shared only if you tick the consent box.
PAGE_HELP_S3_P: Sign in, choose Submit, and complete the five steps. After submission you get a reference ID. Track the status under My Submissions.
PAGE_HELP_S4_P: If you forgot your password, use the reset link on the sign-in page. A verification code is sent to your email. You can switch between Bengali and English at any time.
PAGE_CONTACT_INTRO: How to reach the Jamaat Connect team.
PAGE_CONTACT_S1_P: If a listing looks wrong, misleading or abusive, use the Report button on that listing page so a moderator can review it.
PAGE_CONTACT_S2_P: For anything else, such as account deletion or privacy requests, please contact the site administrator through the channel where you found this platform. A dedicated support address will be published here.
PAGE_PRIVACY_INTRO: What we collect, why, and who can see it.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S1_P: Account details (name, email, optional phone), the listings you submit, private verification contact details you provide with a listing, and enquiries you send (name, message, and optional phone or WhatsApp number).
PAGE_PRIVACY_S2_P: To run the platform: show approved listings, let moderators verify submissions, deliver your enquiries to organizers, send account emails such as verification codes, and prevent abuse.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S3_P: Only the public listing details are visible to everyone. Private submitter and verification contact details are visible only to authorized moderators and administrators. An organizer sees your phone or WhatsApp number only if you consent when sending an enquiry.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S4_P: When you sign in, the site stores your sign-in tokens and basic profile in your browser’s local storage, and it remembers your language choice there. Signing out removes the sign-in data.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S5_P: Passwords are stored as hashes, access to private data is restricted by role, and public endpoints are rate limited. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S6_P: We keep data only as long as needed to run the service, handle moderation and abuse, and meet legal obligations. You can ask to delete your account; some records may be retained where the law or safety requires it.
PAGE_PRIVACY_S7_P: We may update this policy as the platform grows. The date at the top of the page shows the latest revision.
PAGE_TERMS_INTRO: By using Jamaat Connect you agree to these terms.
PAGE_TERMS_S1_P: You may browse listings without an account. Some features need an account, and you are responsible for keeping your password secure and your details accurate.
PAGE_TERMS_S2_P: You confirm that what you submit is accurate to the best of your knowledge. Submitting a listing does not make you the official organizer. All listings are moderated and may be edited, rejected, suspended or removed.
PAGE_TERMS_S3_P: Use enquiries only for genuine questions. Do not harass organizers or other users, and do not use contact details you receive for any other purpose.
PAGE_TERMS_S4_P: Listings are submitted by community members. Jamaat Connect does not claim that any person or group is religiously endorsed, and you should use your own judgement before joining any activity.
PAGE_TERMS_S5_P: The service is provided as is. We do not guarantee that it will always be available or error free, and we are not liable for decisions made based on listing information.
PAGE_TERMS_S6_P: We may update these terms. Continuing to use the platform after a change means you accept the updated terms.
PAGE_REPORT_INTRO: Tell us when a listing is misleading, inappropriate, spam or a duplicate.
PAGE_REPORT_S1_P: Open the listing, choose the Report button, select a reason and describe the problem. You do not need an account.
PAGE_REPORT_S2_P: Say what is wrong and, if you can, what the correct information is. Please do not include private details about other people.
PAGE_REPORT_S3_P: A moderator reviews each report. They may keep the listing, request changes from the submitter, or suspend it.
